description: This file is a unit test for the ScopeRepository class in the OAuth module of the OrangeHRM system. It defines test cases to verify the behavior of methods like getScopeEntityByIdentifier and finalizeScopes within the repository.

classes.name: ScopeRepositoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing ScopeRepository functionalities within the OAuth module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: testGetScopeEntityByIdentifier
methods.description: Tests that retrieving a scope entity by the identifier 'profile' returns null, indicating that such a scope does not exist or is not configured.

methods.name: testFinalizeScopes
methods.description: Tests the finalizeScopes method with an empty scopes array and a specific client entity, expecting an empty result indicating no additional scopes are added.
